timeline.text: One morning, a website just vanished — no warning, no error.
The hosting provider blocked the whole account overnight, taking two sites down with it.
Trusting someone else's goodwill wasn't a plan — like a landlord who could lock the door.
So the site moved onto its own server, deploying straight from GitHub on every push.
A broken deploy rolls itself back instead of leaving the site down.
Back online in a day, deploys landing in two minutes, every time.
